limits: Metrics/masks only; no corrective or weight mutation.
Orientation opposition is a transported-normal witness, not a self-intersection proof.
Closed sections are not whole-garment volume.
C1 OFF/ON hand movement is measured natural girdle translation, not automatically an anchor failure.

candidate.boundary: No whole broad-head zero assumption: this target excludes all neck/head by independent spatial limit; original C1 neck motion retained.
